cli.usage:
Usage:
  mytgfs version    print version and runtime (supports --json)
  mytgfs auth bot   log in with a bot token
  mytgfs auth user  log in with a phone number (code prompted at runtime)
  mytgfs channel init --bot <username>  create a private channel and promote the bot
  mytgfs volume create --name <name>  create a volume: channel, bot, muted notifications
  mytgfs volume delete --name <name>  delete a volume: channel, config entry, local index
  mytgfs volume check  verify every volume's channel
  mytgfs webdav [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--name VOL]  start the WebDAV server
  mytgfs unmap --addr 127.0.0.1:8080  remove network mappings to this server
  mytgfs ls [--name VOL] [DIR]  list a directory
  mytgfs mkdir [--name VOL] <DIR>  create a directory
  mytgfs rm [--name VOL] <PATH...>  delete files or directories (recursive)
  mytgfs mv [--name VOL] <SRC> <DST>  move or rename
  mytgfs get [--name VOL] <REMOTE> [LOCAL|-]  download a file
  mytgfs search [--name VOL] [--dir DIR] [--limit N] <QUERY>  search by file name
  mytgfs cp [--name VOL] [--to DST_VOL] [--force] <SRC> <DST>  copy by reference
  mytgfs put [--name VOL] [--remote /dir] <LOCAL...>  upload files or directories
  mytgfs sync        rebuild the index from channel history
  mytgfs check [--name VOL] [--fix]  compare index with channel and repair
  mytgfs config show|get|set|keys  read/write config (same as the panel)
  mytgfs web [--port N] [--no-open]  local web panel (port defaults to [web].port)
  mytgfs tray [--port N]  system tray: WebDAV, auto sync, panel
  mytgfs startup enable|disable|status  run at login (off by default)

Environment:
  MYTGFS_API_ID  override api_id
  MYTGFS_PHONE   phone number for user login
  MYTGFS_2FA     optional 2FA password for user login
  MYTGFS_LANG    force a language
